extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A texture image dataset generated from text prompts using Stable Diffusion and refined through frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring; it contains 246,285 images across 56 texture classes.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak and Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by constructing descriptive texture prompts, generating images from those prompts with Stable Diffusion, regenerating images flagged by the NSFW filter to maintain a consistent number of images, and then refining the generated images through frequency filtering, patch variance filtering, and CLIP score filtering.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consisted of generated texture images produced from 96,768 unique text prompts using Stable Diffusion; 5 non-flagged images were generated per prompt, yielding 483,840 images before refinement.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images flagged by the NSFW filter were regenerated to ensure a consistent number of images per prompt; flagged images were excluded from the final released dataset for ethical reasons.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A three-stage refinement process was applied: frequency filtering retained the top 80% of images with the highest frequency cutoff values to remove object-like images; patch variance filtering removed the bottom 20% of images with the lowest mean patch variance within each texture class; CLIP score filtering removed the bottom 20% of images with the lowest CLIP scores within each texture class.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human evaluation annotations were collected from 9 participants. Each participant rated 100 randomly ordered images on two questions: overall image quality and how well the image represented the provided descriptor, using a 1 to 5 scale. In total, 900 unique images were evaluated.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The authors analyzed mean human quality and representativeness scores across refinement stages and compared human representativeness scores with CLIP scores, finding gradual improvement through refinement and alignment between human judgments and CLIP-based measures.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to support interpretability, bias analysis, robustness research, and measuring texture bias and model trustworthiness.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper discusses model texture bias and notes that the dataset itself is not overly biased toward a certain frequency, based on Fourier analysis.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Stable Diffusion is not explicitly designed to create textures, so object-like images may be generated; NSFW filtering incorrectly flags many benign texture images; and there is room for improvement in generating more structured textures such as grid and polka-dotted textures.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for texture-based research and applications, including understanding high-level features learned by models, uncovering biases, identifying security vulnerabilities, evaluating texture quality/diversity/representativeness, and measuring texture bias through Texture Object Association Values (TAV).
